# add lower command

Add a `lower` command that lowercases its input — the example is a UUID copied from a tool that prints them in capitals:

```bash
$ lower 33C8964B-0CB1-4496-80E6-EDDE7279D54D
```

It should take either arguments or stdin, so that it works both typed and in a pipe.
